rows.corpus_definition: Very small in degree or amount.
rows.example_en: There was a slight change in the plan.

rows.corpus_definition: To break something into many small pieces with force.
rows.example_en: He managed to smash the window with a rock.

rows.corpus_definition: To make a short, sharp sound.
rows.example_en: The dry branch started to snap.

rows.corpus_definition: To take something away quickly and suddenly.
rows.example_en: The bird tried to snatch the bread away.

rows.corpus_definition: To move somewhere quietly so that no one sees you.
rows.example_en: He tried to sneak out of the room.

rows.corpus_definition: to stay in water for a long time to get very wet
rows.example_en: Let the dirty plates soak in the sink.

rows.corpus_definition: Programs used by a computer to function.
rows.example_en: You need to update your phone software now.

rows.corpus_definition: Relating to the light or heat from the sun.
rows.example_en: They installed solar panels on the roof.

rows.corpus_definition: The sun and all the objects that travel around it.
rows.example_en: Nine planets are in our solar system.

rows.corpus_definition: Being the only one of its kind.
rows.example_en: He is the sole owner of this small shop.
